summary: Charles & Colvard Ltd., a jewelry manufacturer, filed an 8-K detailing its Chapter 11 bankruptcy process and a stalking horse asset purchase agreement with Van Lang Jewelry LLC/Jewelry Design Partners LLC. The Buyer will acquire substantially all assets for $1.5M, subject to a credit bid offset against DIP facility debt. The Bankruptcy Court approved the stalking horse bidder and credit-bid rights on April 29, 2026. The filing also notes the Executive Chair's extension to a month-to-month term at $7,500/month. Watch for competing bids at a potential auction or court approval of the sale, with risk-arb focusing on creditor recovery and potential higher offers.
